recognize_zh: 周邊血液中兩顆嗜中性球核分葉不足：右下那顆呈花生／啞鈴狀的雙葉核（pince-nez），左上那顆為未分葉的腎形核，但兩者染色質都已粗塊濃縮、細胞質顆粒成熟，符合 Pelger-Huët 變異。
features: Lower right cell: bilobed peanut/dumbbell-shaped nucleus (pince-nez form)
Upper left cell: non-segmented, kidney-shaped nucleus
Coarse, clumped mature chromatin in both cells
Pale cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules; small vacuoles in the lower right cell
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophils with hyposegmented nuclei. The cell at lower right has a bilobed, peanut-shaped (pince-nez) nucleus, and the cell at upper left has a non-segmented kidney-shaped nucleus. Both show coarsely clumped mature chromatin and pale cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules, and the lower right cell contains a few small cytoplasmic vacuoles. Findings are consistent with Pelger-Huët-type hyposegmented neutrophils; distinguishing the inherited anomaly from acquired pseudo-Pelger-Huët change requires assessing the proportion of affected cells, granulation and clinical history.

ddx.vs: Band neutrophils have a curved sausage-shaped nucleus with less condensed chromatin, whereas these cells show coarse mature chromatin with dumbbell or non-lobed forms.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Pelger-Huët anomaly (MDS, drugs such as mycophenolate)
ddx.vs: Acquired forms frequently accompany hypogranularity and other dysplasia and affect a variable subset of neutrophils, whereas the inherited anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils.
Metamyelocytes have a kidney-shaped nucleus with less condensed chromatin and occur in marrow or left-shifted blood, not with fully mature clumped chromatin.
